items.author: runolllo.bsky.social
items.context: I think I might be too stupid to play creative games or maybe it's ADHD??? Or maybe Pokopia just makes inventory management impossible. In other such games I play (say Stardew, Mistria, Starbound, Core Keeper) I get overwhelmed too with so many items but never to the absurd level as in Pokopia...
items.text: Inventory piles up fast in these games, so you're definitely not alone. In Stardew, colour-coded chests with one type of item each keep it manageable.

items.author: wolfdude91.bsky.social
items.context: Wait cozy games aren’t for boys?
items.text: Cozy games are for anyone who likes calm. Stardew Valley and A Short Hike are both easy places to start.
